title_en: The Best Gift Ideas at Men's Wearhouse This Holiday Season
summary_en: A great way to refresh the closet.
body_en:
Editor's Note: This article is sponsored by Men's Wearhouse.
Black Friday is almost here, and with it come some of the biggest savings of the year. While there are numerous deals to be found on video games , Blu-rays , and tech , there are also many great deals on clothing available. One of our favorite sales is at Men's Wearhouse, where you can save on suits, dress shirts, shoes, pants, and much more. This is one of the best times of the year to save money on dressier clothes that usually aren't cheap, making these deals a perfect choice for a gift. Below, we've compiled a list of our favorite gifts from Men's Wearhouse this holiday season.
Men's Wearhouse 2026 Holiday Gift Ideas:
As someone who wears dress shirts daily and sometimes suits, I'd be happy to receive any of these items as a gift. New clothes can get expensive fast, and you can find endless options at Men's Wearhouse right now that will instantly make the MVP of Christmas morning. There are some notable brands available to choose from, including Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, Kenneth Cole, Joseph Abboud, Michael Kors, and more.
Men's Wearhouse has an excellent selection of dress shirts that fit right in the range of being not cheap, but not too expensive. Even on a short budget, you can likely pick up a pair of dress shirts for under $100, possibly three. There's a good variety of fits and styles available, with straight, classic, slim, and more fits available. You can choose from typical colors like blue or white, as well as patterned options, too.
Alongside dress shirts, Men's Wearhouse also has a great selection of casual shirts that can make a great gift. Styles include standard crewneck tees, polos, button-ups, quarter-zips, and more. These can be a great way to shake up the wardrobe, as often, you can layer these pieces together to make entirely new outfits. I found quite a few casual polos on sale, too, so I recommend looking here if you want to find a gift on the cheaper side.
Suits & Sport Coats
If there is one category of items that Men's Wearhouse is best known for, it's suits. There are so many options to choose from, with prices ranging from just $150 to over $500 for a two piece suit. You may be surprised by just how many colors and materials there are to choose from. Of course, if a full suit is not what you are looking for, a sport coat is a great alternative. A patterned sport coat can make a great gift, and you can't go wrong with a simple solid either.
Pants
Another fantastic route you could go down is buying some pants as a gift this holiday season. Even just one extra pair of dress pants can save you from having to mad dash to the dry cleaners, making this a great choice for any professional. I like the selection at Men's Wearhouse quite a bit, as there are regular dress pants, chinos, five-pocket pants, golf pants, and even shorts.
Depending on the office, chinos and golf pants may be the go-to for daily work. Men's Wearhouse has PGA Tour brand golf pants and shorts available, and these are really comfortable overall. You can easily pull them off for a day in the office, golfing, or even dinner. They're versatile, and the same goes for chinos.
You can find even more gift ideas for the holiday season at Men's Wearhouse, including savings on shoes, sweaters, outerwear, and accesorries.
Noah Hunter is a freelance writer and reviewer covering games and technology. When he's not writing for IGN, he runs Final Weapon, a site focused on Japanese games and anime. His favorite series include Xeno, Fate, Final Fantasy, and far too many RPGs to list.
